newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee rock-steady v dlr, forward premia ease.
newsitem.headline: India rupee rock-steady v dlr, forward premia ease.

text.p: The Indian rupee was rock-steady at 35.62/63 per dollar on Monday, unchanged from the weekend levels, dealers said.
"It was very quiet," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Dollar supply continued to be good and demand was minimal, a trend seen over the past few weeks, dealers said.
The Reserve Bank of India was in the market buying dollars at 35.6250/6300 level, one dealer said.
The forward dollar premia eased by about five paise for every month amid a shortage of payers. Receivers are banking on a cut in cash reserve requirement for banks, dealers said.
